title: Encode and Decode Base32
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Encode and Decode Base32.
learning_objectives: Explain encode and decode base32 using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for encode and decode base32

base32encode/base32decode use lowercase RFC-style alphabet symbols.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
